items.title: mai
items.text:
mai's goal is to provide a fully API-compatible veraPDF alternative, written in Rust.

Warning

mai is an experimental project and isn't already usable. Current focus is on validating PDF/A-1b.

items.title: Python package
items.text: mai validation is available as a Python package.

items.title: Rust crate
items.text: mai validation is available as a Rust crate.
